Backup and restore

Copy this text to keep a backup. Paste a backup here and choose Restore to load it.

Privacy: Daybook keeps your habits, plans, notes, mood, sleep, workouts, meals, weight, trading entries, business records and settings only in this browser. There is no account and no server copy, and nothing you write is sent to any service (only the page fonts load from Google Fonts). Browser storage is not encrypted, so anyone who can open Daybook in your unlocked browser can read it. A backup without a password is plain readable text; with a password it is encrypted, and a forgotten password cannot be recovered. Clearing this site’s data removes everything.
